capabilities: Extract highlighted, underlined and annotated text from PDFs into a Markdown file
Sort extracted highlights by position in the document and page
Optionally include page numbers with each highlight
Optionally show the highlight color and group by color
Optionally create links for list items pointing back to the PDF
extras: README includes a public backlog (ICEBOX/TODO/DOING/DONE); planned features include auto-creating notes from links with the highlight as a quote and a progress modal for long PDFs.
intentEvidence: Decide if to integrate with existing Highlights Plugin
problem: Reading PDFs in Obsidian leaves highlights and annotations locked in the PDF; there is no built-in way to turn them into Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin stands on the shoulders of Joseph Devietti and his 2012 pull-request for PDFJS.

summary: PDF highlight extractor that pulls highlighted, underlined and annotated text from PDFs into a Markdown note in the vault.
